data.name: Pugal
data.gender_notes: Pugal is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who holds the fort, one who is a fortress or stronghold. Derived from the Tamil word 'pugazh' meaning fort, and 'al' meaning one who holds. The name is often given to children born into royal families or those who are expected to lead. The name Pugal carries the meaning “Fortress, Stronghold” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Pugal usually hope their child will grow to embody fortress, stronghold and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength, courage, and wisdom. It is believed that those named Pugal are destined to protect and lead their communities and families, and possess the qualities of a strong and unwavering leader.
data.etymology: Pugal belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fortress, Stronghold.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pugal total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
